title: Interview with Celina Lee
summary: The insight2impact I i2i facility is pleased to welcome Celina Lee as Lead. Celina brings 15 years of financial inclusion, data and management experience from across Latin America, Asia and Africa.
body:
The insight2impact I i2i facility is pleased to welcome [Celina Lee](https://finmark.org.za/about) as Lead. Celina brings 15 years of financial inclusion, data and management experience from across Latin America, Asia and Africa.
